title: 2 Timothy
author: Paul the apostle.
date: Near the end of Paul's life, first century A.D.
historicalSetting: Paul urges Timothy to endure, preach the Word, guard the Gospel, and remain faithful.
keyVerse: 2 Timothy 3:16 — "Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable."
christFocus: Second Timothy points to Christ as the risen Lord for whom believers suffer and the faithful Savior who strengthens His servants to finish well.
outline: Endure as a faithful servant — 2 Timothy 2
